edits.why: maude-v2 scopes its tokens to .maude-v2[data-theme] (the .maude scope would no longer match), and its core components (callout, card, dialog, checkbox) only apply under :where(.ds).
maude-v2 has no btn--icon; its icon button is .icon-btn (components.json IconButton).

notes: Locked: the 'Changes' tab (data-cd-id="changes", data-cd-locked) uses className="tab", which maude-v2 does not have (its Tabs map to the .seg segmented control). It is left exactly as it is; to move both tabs to .seg, someone unlocks it first (⇧⌘L). The 'History' tab is left too, so the pair stays matched.

Decision: .panel (1 use, panel gp-mini) has no maude-v2 rule. Its closest match is .island (ext.Island). The local gp- classes still style the panel, so it renders; whether to adopt .island is a look decision.

Decision: .tree-row (7 uses) has no maude-v2 rule; the closest is .row-item (ext.ListRow). Not renamed: the local gp-row styling keeps the rows readable, and .row-item brings its own padding and hover.

Decision: callout--info and callout--warn have no tone in maude-v2 (Callout variants are all null). Base .callout applies under .ds; the tone colour is lost unless GitPanel.css adds it, or the system adds variants.
Line heights change from fixed px (20px base) to ratios (1.45 base): text runs slightly tighter.
maude-v2's :root default is light; this canvas sets data-theme="dark" explicitly, so it stays dark.

Comments only: GitPanel.css line 3 and the TSX docblock still mention system/maude. The design is 'handed-off' (handoffCommit 97859dc); GitPanel.registry.json still describes the maude build until the handoff is redone.
